elena: Hey @support, our customers hit a hard failure when we switched to structured output mode. Suddenly our ingestion lambda throws JSON parse errors.
sophie: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the request + response and a repro curl? Also which model + api params you used.
elena: Repro below. We call the Redwood API with response_format set to our JSON schema. Payload: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-1-large","input":"Generate invoice item as JSON","response_format": {"type":"json_schema","json_schema": {"type":"object","properties": {"id": {"type":"integer"}, "price": {"type":"number"}, "status": {"type":"string","enum":["Pending","Paid","Cancelled"]}, "is_refundable": {"type":"boolean"}},"required":["id","price","status"]}}}'``` 
elena: The API returns 200 but the body is not valid JSON (parser error in our stack). Response snippet we logged: ```{"id":"12345","price":"12.34","status":"pending","is_refundable":"false"}``` — note id and price are strings, status is lowercase, is_refundable is string "false". Our JSON parser (strict typed struct) fails on converting id -> int.
mia: Hm that looks like classic type drift from the model. In structured mode we expect the model to follow the schema strictly, but models sometimes emit everything as strings. Do you have the raw model text output? any extra punctuation or comments?
elena: Raw text exactly matches the snippet above, no extra commentary. We reproduced by hitting the API 5x.
sophie: Thanks. Can you attach the request ids or correlation ids from the API responses? Also which sdk/version?
elena: Request IDs: rqx-8b3e, rqx-8b3f, rqx-8b40. Using node sdk 2.1.0.
raj: tagging eng-ml / eng-runtime — @mia can you triage? initial thought: model is outputting numerics as quoted strings and enum lowercase. Two approaches: (1) prompt-level mitigation: add explicit instruction and examples to ensure numbers are unquoted and enums use exact casing; (2) service-level post-processing coercion to accept numeric strings and boolean strings; or (3) relax schema to oneOf number|string with numeric pattern.
mia: I can add a quick prompt patch: append to user's prompt: "Return JSON that strictly matches the schema: numbers MUST be unquoted (e.g., 12.34), booleans MUST be true/false (no quotes), enums MUST match exact casing. Do not wrap values in quotes." That usually fixes one-off cases.
raj: For a more robust fix, eng-runtime should implement an optional coercion pass for structured outputs: when schema expects number/boolean but value is a string that matches a numeric/boolean pattern, coerce. We should log coercions and only enable via param (eg allow_type_coercion=true) until we confirm safe.
mia: Agree. I can prototype the coercion in the post-processor. Edge cases: leading zeros, commas, currency symbols, and ambiguous strings ("0" vs "false"). We'll implement strict regex checks: number -> ^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$, boolean -> ^(?:true|false)$ (case-insensitive?). For enums we should support case-insensitive match optionally, but prefer to warn rather than auto-fix.
sophie: Customer impact: this tenant uses strict typed ingestion and can't accept coerced values without a migration. We need to offer short-term workaround. @elena can you change your ingestion to accept string->number conversion? If not, we'll patch either prompt or enable a customer-scoped coercion flag.
elena: We can't deploy parser changes quickly. Can you enable a flag on our account? Our account id: acct-7742. This is blocking several invoices.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: rollout/structured-coercion/proto -> canary on dedicated for acct-7742
mia: Filed a small canary PR to add per-customer allow_type_coercion. It will run a deterministic coercion pass and emit a header X-Redwood-Coercion: id=... when any coercion occurs. I'll follow up with logs for your request ids.
raj: Also adding a recommended schema example to docs: show a tolerant JSON Schema snippet: ```"price": {"oneOf": [{"type":"number"},{"type":"string","pattern":"^-?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?$"}]}``` — and show prompt template to enforce casing for enums.
sophie: Action items: mia to enable canary for acct-7742 and post logs; raj to update docs and advise on long-term runtime behavior; elena to confirm once canary is live we re-run the failing requests. ETA: canary today afternoon.
elena: Thanks all — really appreciate the quick turnaround. Please @mention me when the canary is live. :heart:
mia: Will do. Posting follow-up logs once canary has processed rqx-8b3e/8b3f/8b40. Expect notification in ~2h.
(End of thread)
